project_overview: CCTNS V1.0 is a system designed to improve crime investigation and criminal detection processes for police personnel.

actors.name: PoliceOfficer
actors.description: Police personnel responsible for case investigation

actors.name: Citizen
actors.description: Public user who can register complaints

functions.name: ConfigureSystem
acceptance_criteria: 配置应反映在系统行为中
管理员应能轻松更新配置

functions.name: CustomizeUI
sub_capabilities: 移动和调整界面元素大小
acceptance_criteria: 用户配置应保存在用户配置文件中
界面应允许最大程度的自定义

functions.name: ExportAudit
functions.description: Exports audit trails for specified cases
acceptance_criteria: Audit data is exported without affecting stored audit trail
审计员可以导出指定案件的审计跟踪
导出的审计数据不影响系统存储的原始审计跟踪
functions.preconditions: User must have audit access rights

functions.name: InvestigateCase
functions.description: Facilitates the investigation process after complaint registration
acceptance_criteria: All investigation details are recorded
Case status is updated appropriately

functions.name: ManageAccess
sub_capabilities: 设置基于角色的功能控制
acceptance_criteria: 能够将案件访问限制为指定用户或用户组
支持用户成为多个组的成员
只有管理员可以设置用户配置文件和分配用户到组
functions.preconditions: 用户必须具有管理员权限

functions.name: ManageUser
acceptance_criteria: 只有超级用户可以更改组或用户的安全属性
用户配置文件可以正确保存
functions.preconditions: 用户必须具有超级用户权限

functions.name: ProsecuteCase
functions.description: 起诉案件，记录与法院的互动
acceptance_criteria: 能够记录法院互动的详细信息
能够关联到特定案件

functions.name: RegisterCase
functions.description: Allows citizens to register complaints with police
acceptance_criteria: Complaint details are captured accurately
Case reference number is generated

functions.name: SearchCase
acceptance_criteria: Search results are returned within specified time limits
Only accessible cases are shown
能够返回符合条件的案件列表
能够自定义结果视图
functions.preconditions: User must have appropriate access rights

functions.name: SendAlert
acceptance_criteria: 用户可以选择接收警报的方式（如电子邮件、短信）
当相关操作发生时系统自动发送警报
functions.preconditions: 用户已配置警报接收偏好

functions.name: TrackDefect
functions.description: Allows users to log and track defects or enhancement requests
acceptance_criteria: Defect details are captured
Status updates are recorded
用户可以提交缺陷或增强请求
帮助台用户可以查看分类、状态和时效的报告

attributes.name: createdAt
attributes.description: Date and time when case was created

relationships.description: 案件可以有多次起诉记录
